_doc: The per-stage head table of the packets (G-RENDER, test/shiploop_e2e/render_diff.py): the longest printed text each stage may have, in characters, by case, route, run-directory length and CLI path length (the key 'inline/83/96' is route/run directory/CLI path). render_diff exits non-zero when a stage prints more than its value here or has none. A value changes in the commit that journals the new value (the plan's U1 re-baselines it for the merged branches, U7 sets the allocation); no other unit raises it. The first values are main da9e2e75 (skill-craft 2.5.0 / ShipLoop 1.5.0) rendered by packets.py --offline --text-dir and written by render_diff.py --emit-table DIR --write; they are ceilings, not targets, and a stage over the 20,000-character host cut is journaled as such, not hidden here. Re-written 2026-10-17 by packet-review U3/U4 (feat/pr-u3-head-1b7a72) with render_diff.py --emit-table --write on the four renders: the head prints the guides its duties cite and the Backchain lines with the text that cites them (up to +1,200, carry-forward), the one-line pass, floor and ratchet rules (-172 at test and verify); every printed text stays under 20,000 at 83 and 163.
